title: Langtang Lirung, Wednesday

summary.what: Ice came off Langtang Lirung. Bound is provisional.

boundEvent.whatHappened: Ice came off Langtang Lirung. Images are cloudy and dusty. Enough to say ice moved. Not enough to name what failed first.
boundEvent.scale: Ice movement visible; runout and scar not yet isolated
boundEvent.sequence: Ice moved. Initiation is not named.
boundEvent.firstNounRisk: glacier collapse treated as settled initiation

settled: Villages and hydropower works sit downstream in the river path.
provisional: The moving mass included ice. That does not settle what failed first.
"Glacier collapse" is a first noun, not a bound.
open: What failed first (ice, rock, both, something else).
Whether construction vibration reached the face.
Whether climate is the whole trigger.

causalChain.initiation: Unknown. Ice moved. "Glacier collapse" as the whole start is a first-noun risk, not settled initiation.
causalChain.amplification: Not yet split from the Wednesday images.
causalChain.exposure: Villages and hydropower works sit downstream in the river path. That can explain harm later without explaining the scar.

hoopFailures.mechanismKilled: Hydropower "caused the disaster" as a single noun
hoopFailures.constraint: Collapsed chain: the claim does not say whether it is initiation, amplification, exposure, or response.

residualGaps.question: Why did that ice detach?
residualGaps.notes: Wednesday leftover. Do not fill with a preferred actor.

residualGaps.question: Who or what was in the path?
residualGaps.notes: Exposure. Not a rival to initiation.

residualGaps.question: What was the flood water budget?

allowedHypotheses.claim: Ice failed first and the rest followed. Still a hypothesis; Wednesday images do not isolate it.
Something other than hanging ice alone failed first. Wednesday cannot name it.

discriminatingTraces.lookFor: A clearer image of the scar: rock vs ice as the leading mass.

remainder: What failed first is unknown. Construction-as-far-field-resonator and climate-as-whole-trigger are still stories, not hoop-killed on this packet. Remainder is most of the page.
